Import from URL

Downloads an HTTPS video, audio or image into the project media folder. The file is stored locally — the URL is not used as the playback source. Remote SVGs are not imported (they can run script if opened as a document).

Batch outputs

One render, several files: every checked output is encoded from the same frames. Saved with the project.

    WebCodecs has no CRF — quality is driven by bitrate. VBR spends bits on hard frames; CBR holds a steady rate.

    Export queue

      Exporting…

      Rendering your sequence in real time. Keep this tab focused.

      Settings

      Preferences are stored in this browser only.

      Selection

      Keyboard shortcuts

      Playback

      SpacePlay / pause (Source or Program — whichever is active)
      J K LShuttle — L plays forward, J in reverse (silent); tap again for 1.5× · 2× · 4×, the other key turns around; K stops
      K+J / K+LHold K and tap to step one frame; hold both to crawl at ¼ speed
      ← →Step 1 frame (⇧ = 1 second)
      ↑ / ↓Jump to previous / next cut (selected clip In then Out; no selection → targeted tracks). Source monitor: In / Out marks
      Home / EndJump to start / end
      0–9 / click timecodeType a time: 01:15:00, packed 1500 (= 15 s), +30 / -1:00 to offset, 12.5 seconds. Click IN / OUT readouts to type those too
      Limit (toolbar)Play stops at OUT; Home / End use IN / OUT

      Source monitor

      Dbl-click bin / clipLoad into the Source monitor
      ,Insert Source In→Out at the timeline playhead (ripples later clips)
      .Replace — overwrite at the playhead, or apply new Source In / Out to a timeline-loaded clip (ripples if the duration changes)

      Editing

      V B R Y UTools: Selection · Ripple edit (drag an edge, the rest follows) · Rolling edit (drag a cut) · Slip (change the source under a clip) · Slide (move a clip, neighbours trim)
      SSplit clip(s) at the playhead (selection, else targeted tracks)
      [ / ]Trim selected in / out to the playhead
      DelDelete selected clip(s), or clear the focused transition
      ⇧+DelRipple delete — remove the selection and close the gap on targeted tracks
      GFind the next shared gap (wraps; respects IN / OUT)
      ⇧+GClose the gap at the playhead (targeted tracks)
      Alt+TAdd a transition at the playhead (in / out by half)
      ⇧+EDisable / enable selected clip(s) — hidden from preview and export
      Ctrl/Cmd+LUnlink / link video and its audio
      Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+⇧+ZUndo / redo (also Ctrl+Y)

      Selection

      Drag empty areaMarquee-select clips
      Ctrl+click clipAdd to / remove from the selection
      Ctrl+A / EscSelect all / deselect
      Right-click clipDisable / lock / link or unlink / precompose

      IN / OUT and markers

      I / OSet Source In / Out (Source mode) or the timeline work area (Program; also bounds Export)
      ⇧+I / ⇧+OClear Source or timeline IN / OUT
      TSplit clips at the IN / OUT marks
      ⇧+TTrim clips to IN / OUT (remove heads and tails)
      ; / 'Lift / Extract IN→OUT on targeted tracks (Extract closes the gap)
      MAdd / remove a marker at the playhead
      ⇧+M / Alt+⇧+MGo to the next / previous marker
      Marker on rulerDrag to move · click to jump · double-click or right-click to name / colour / delete · Markers lists them all

      Timeline view and tracks

      + / -Zoom the timeline
      Ctrl+wheelZoom at the cursor
      ZZoom to the selected clip(s)
      Alt+ZZoom to the IN–OUT work area
      ⇧+ZZoom to fit
      NSnapping on / off — ▾ picks targets (clip edges, playhead, markers, IN / OUT, keyframes, frame grid)
      Click track nameTarget / untarget the track — edits touch lit (targeted) tracks only
      Track SSolo the track (mutes all others; click again to restore)
      Track padlockLock the track — nothing on it can be edited or moved
      Right-click trackRemove an empty track (keeps ≥1 video + ≥1 audio)

      Keyframes, presets and Inspector

      Ctrl/Cmd+← / →Go to the previous / next keyframe (the Inspector follows)
      Ctrl/Cmd+click inspector label or sliderReset a property and clear all its keyframes
      ⇧+click labelReset the value at the playhead, or remove that keyframe
      Motion → PresetsIn · Out · At playhead · Loop menus key a ready-made animation onto the selected clips · Save as preset keeps this clip's keyframes for every project

      Audio

      Volume lineDrag to change the level · Ctrl/Cmd+click adds a keyframe · Alt+click or double-click removes one · corner grips drag fades
      ⇧+DCrossfade the audio cut next to the selected clip (or at the playhead)

      Bin, compositions and templates

      Ctrl+click binImport media files
      Right-click Project tabNew folder · New composition
      Bin searchName, kind, codec, 2160p or a tag; #tag matches tags only · Esc clears
      Right-click a bin fileFind timeline instances · Media info · favorites · Tags · collections
      ☆ / uses badge on a bin fileStar it · list where it is used (click one to jump there)
      ☰ in the binList view with metadata columns · click a heading to sort
      Right-click a clipReveal in project — show its file in the bin
      Right-click a bin fileRelink… — point it at the footage where it is now · Replace file… — a new file for every clip that uses it
      Right-click a bin videoCreate proxy — a light copy to edit with (right-click the Project tab for all of them) · Proxy above the monitor plays proxies on / off; export always uses the originals
      Comp clip / bin compDouble-click to open it on the timeline · drag a bin comp onto the timeline to place it · the breadcrumb above the timeline steps back out
      Right-click clipsPrecompose — move the selection into a new comp
      Esc inside a compBack out one level (once nothing is selected)
      Templates tabDrag a lower third, logo animation or social layout onto the timeline (or click ＋) · fill in its fields in the Inspector's Template section · right-click a comp → Save as template

      Projects top bar → Projects

      Ctrl/Cmd+OOpen the Projects dashboard (or click the project name)
      Ctrl/Cmd+SSave a version of the open project (every edit is saved anyway; a version is a point to come back to)
      Project → Versions…Compare a version with now · Restore… (click twice; what is there is saved as a version first) · mark the final cut
      Timeline toolbar → sequence menuOpen another sequence of this project · New sequence… (any canvas, empty or a copy) · Duplicate · Rename… · Delete… (click twice; kept as a version first)
      Project cardClick to see its details, notes and tags · double-click to open it
      Enter on a cardOpen that project
      EscBack out of New project, then close the dashboard
      Delete… (Archived)Click twice — only archived projects can be deleted

      Color workspace

      Colour wheelDrag to tint (⇧ = fine) · double-click resets the colour · double-click a label or slider name to reset it
      WB pick / PickClick the monitor to balance, to mark a colour on the curves, or to select it in a layer's qualifier · Esc cancels
      CurvesClick adds a point on the curve · drag moves it · double-click removes it
      Layer mask on monitorDrag inside to move · handles resize · the knob rotates (⇧ snaps to 15°) · poly / bezier: Ctrl/Cmd+click adds a point, double-click removes one · Draw: drag a free-hand outline

      Masks Inspector → Masks

      PenClick to place points, drag while placing to pull curve handles · click the first point or Enter closes · Ctrl+Z / Backspace removes the last point, Ctrl+⇧+Z puts it back · Esc cancels
      DrawDrag a free-hand outline — it becomes an editable bezier
      Mask on monitorDrag inside to move · edge handles resize · the knob rotates (⇧ snaps to 15°) · drag a point or its handles (Alt breaks the pair) · Alt+drag a point pulls new handles · Ctrl/Cmd+click the outline adds a point · double-click a point removes it · Esc deselects

      Shapes and transforms bin → Shapes · Inspector

      Shape item on monitorDrag inside to move · corners resize (⇧ keeps the proportions) · the knob rotates (⇧ snaps to 15°) · line / path: drag a point or its handles (Alt breaks the pair), Alt+drag a point pulls new handles · path: Ctrl/Cmd+click the outline adds a point, double-click a point removes it · Esc deselects
      Shape / text-path penClick to place points, drag while placing to pull curve handles · click the first point closes the path · Enter keeps it open · Ctrl+Z / Backspace removes the last point, Ctrl+⇧+Z puts it back · Esc cancels
      Motion pathDrag a key square to move it · drag a handle to bend the path (Alt breaks the pair) · Alt+drag a key pulls new handles · double-click a key makes it a corner again
      Anchor ✥ MoveDrag on the monitor to move the anchor point; the picture stays put (⇧ snaps to its centre) · Esc turns it off

      Tracking Inspector → Tracking · a mask’s Track buttons

      Track pointClick the spot to follow on the monitor — it tracks from the playhead to the clip's end · Esc cancels the pick, or stops a running track (what was tracked so far is kept)

      Transcript side panel → Transcript

      Click a wordGo to it · ⇧+click or drag selects a run of words
      DelCut the selected words and the pause after them (extract on the targeted tracks) · Esc clears the selection
      Find wordsEnter / ⇧+Enter go to the next / previous match · Cut extracts every match
      CaptionsPick a style, then Add captions (one undo step; replaces the captions there) · SRT / VTT download them · Import… places a subtitle file's captions

      No shortcut matches that.
